title: Small uncensored agents: what a 4.5B Heretic distill is for
summary: A source-linked field note on insraq's Heretic v1.4.0 decensor of EmperoAI's Qwen3.8-4B distill: what the 4.5B class is for, and what it trades away.

title: What 'Aggressive' means: Muse-Glimmer-30B abliterated to 0/100 refusals
summary: A relaxed-KL LoRA de-abliteration of Meta's 29.8B agentic model claiming 0/100 refusals at ~1.7x KL drift — a mirror upload with the benchmarks left unmeasured.

title: The 2.78-trillion-parameter abliteration nobody can run
summary: An abliterated re-upload of Moonshot's 2.78T-parameter Kimi K3 — any-to-any, MXFP4, 96 shards, ~1.56 TB — with zero downloads and no deployment: the scale math behind why nobody can run it.

title: The 48-hour abliteration race
summary: Within 48 hours of Qwen3.8-27B's community release, huihui-ai published a 27.8B-parameter abliterated edit that leaves the first 15 layers, MTP and the vision tower untouched, and its GGUF companion landed the same afternoon.

title: DeepSeek V4 Flash, uncensored by dial: 757 KB against 284B
summary: A 757 KB refusal-directions file turns DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 abliteration into a runtime λ dial, with measured proof that the baked λ=2.5 checkpoint overshoots and inverts the direction.

title: The base of the wave: Muse-Glimmer-30B's measured de-refusal
summary: jorkle's KL-measured LoRA-SFT de-refusal of Meta's dense 29.8B agentic model — the Normal twin of a three-repo family with its own GGUF ladder and base-reference quants.

title: A pentesting model, with the refusals taken out
summary: An abliterated fine-tune of the CyberStrike-OffSec-35B offensive-security model: a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B tool-calling base, refusal weights edited out, no post-edit evaluations published.

title: Qwythos 9B: a model with three lives
summary: Qwen architecture, Empero post-training and huihui-ai's final refusal-reduction pass, with a 1M label that deserves a closer look.

title: Inside Huihui-Qwen3.6: 256 experts and one refusal direction
summary: The multimodal proof of concept: how huihui-ai applied abliteration to a 36-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts checkpoint, and why uncensored still needs caveats.

title: Ornith 397B: surgery on a model too large to hold at once
summary: A shard-by-shard abliteration and W4A16 conversion of a 396.8-billion-parameter sparse model that still produces nearly 196 GiB of weights.

title: Ornith 35B: can self-scaffolding survive abliteration?
summary: DeepReinforce's coding scaffold, YuYu1015's corrected weights and the boundary between upstream and derivative benchmarks.

title: The workhorse: Huihui-Qwen3.6-27B-abliterated, four months in
summary: 18,760 downloads in four months: what the community actually runs a dense 27B Qwen abliteration for, from red-teaming to quantization, and what its users report back.

title: The quiet classic: how Huihui-Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated became the small-model default
summary: Abliterated Qwen3.5-9B (9,653,104,368 params, Apache-2.0) published 9 March 2026: 9,195 downloads and 125 likes on the base, with 58 downstream repos — GGUF/AWQ/MLX conversions and a preference-tuned Grimoire family — holding 64,688 combined downloads.

title: The MIT vision sleeper that resurfaced in August
summary: MIT-licensed text-side abliteration of Zhipu's GLM-4.6V-Flash vision model (10,292,777,472 params), published 9 December 2025, dormant for eight months, freshly re-quantized with vision-projector files on 17 August 2026.
